question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this persistent, experimental Claw workspace-file lifecycle as a core feature in the ordered RFC stack?
rationale: The patch is a new core filesystem and provenance contract rather than a repair to an established behavior; selecting its long-term owner and acceptance boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental slice
options.body: Accept the create-only, consent-bound workspace-file lifecycle as a core experimental capability and review/land it in stack order.

options.title: Pause the core direction
options.body: Do not merge this slice until an owner confirms that managed workspace files and their persistent provenance belong in OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental slice
recommendation.body: Accept the create-only, consent-bound workspace-file lifecycle as a core experimental capability and review/land it in stack order.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review directly articulated the safety invariants and ownership concerns that determine whether this core lifecycle should proceed.
